title: PromotionUniV2_Eth Leg A now trades on the same shallow phUSD/sUSDS V2 pair UniPoolerV2.pool zaps into: cross-call quote interference forces self-DoS or widened tolerances that a single searcher can stack across both calls (L-15 premise re-weigh)
borderlineNote: Not a severity borderline - a DUPLICATE borderline: owner may rule that wont-fix L-15 e64f73d629 already covers it. Disclose L-15's verbatim triageReason in the submission; note its 'all 5 floors present' premise is only parametric (4 accept 0).
description: CODE-002 (1,000-sUSDS zap cuts a ~570-share Leg A out by 2.83%; Leg A cuts the zap by 3.26%; same-block batching -> revert below ~3% tolerance or widening to >=3.5% that one front-run harvests twice). PATTERN-003: venue change warrants re-confirming L-15 rather than silent inheritance. LOCAL-PR-001: Leg A zero-floor guard is nominal (1 passes) and the other four floors (minEthOut/minPromoOut/minWbtcOut/minLP) still accept 0 — inside L-15's acceptance, recorded so it is not re-filed separately.
impact: POL only. Same-block batching of UniPoolerV2.pool and PromotionUniV2_Eth Leg A on the shared phUSD/sUSDS pair either self-reverts (1k zap moves Leg A out 2.83%, Leg A moves zap 3.26%) or forces tolerances >= ~3.5% that a single front-run harvests across both calls.
attackPath: 1. Keeper quotes both calls against the same pre-state and submits in one block
2. Either the second call reverts on its floor (self-DoS), or keeper widens tolerance
3. With widened tolerance a searcher front-runs once and extracts against both calls
likelihood: low-medium - requires keeper batching on stale quotes
assumptions: Keeper batches both calls; public submission
severityJustification: New cross-contract coupling created by a4d80f4's venue change; extraction remains tolerance-bounded and POL-only, so same severity tier as L-15/L-06. Non-obvious operational coupling (keeper footgun).
recommendation: Never batch UniPoolerV2.pool and PromotionUniV2_Eth.pool in one block; quote the second after the first is mined; private submission. Optional: single entry point sizing both from live reserves.
